question: Fund one 2 h stage to map the seam words and test a closed tape language for this table, or park W4-8 as STUCK at observe?

options.label: One stage (at most 2 h): seam alphabet and closed-language test
options.consequence: Write a seam extractor on the phase-tracked sea (not compress tokens), count distinct seam words and seam/wall collisions to 1e10, and test whether the set saturates. If it does, build the candidate language (u-runs separated by seams from the set) and check that one cycle maps it into itself and excludes 11 0 <C. Stop rule: still growing at 1e10, or not closed in 2 h, means park.

options.label: Park (STUCK at observe)
options.consequence: Keeps the validated rules (RS/LS/LT/RO/Q, halting pattern H), the segment-map scripts and the 2e9 tracker data on file. Stops work on 644, and on 61 and 704 with it.

options.label: Swap W4-8 for a reserve pick
options.consequence: Parks this table as in park and spends the stage on the next unclaimed machine from the Wave 4 reserves.
